_comment: ページ教材の さし絵の うち **図だけ**。参照画像は 絵柄を そろえる ためだけに 渡す ので、ネクマックス（マスコット）が 場面に 入りこまない よう negative で はっきり 断る（scripts/images/matsui_office.json と 同じ 手）。人が 出る 絵は kaisha_pages_people.json。
style: Style: clean flat vector illustration, thick soft hand-drawn outlines, cheerful pastel palette (sky blue, navy, leaf green, coral) on a warm cream background, friendly rounded shapes, generous empty space, calm and tidy, kid-safe e-learning illustration.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image. No watermark, no signature, no logo, no frame border.
negative: Never: realistic photo rendering, harsh gradients, readable letters or numbers, dark horror tone, national flags, country outlines, maps with borders or coastlines. NO PEOPLE and NO CHARACTERS anywhere in the image - no humans, no robots, no mascots, no faces, no hands except where the scene explicitly asks for one. The reference image is ONLY a colour and line-style guide; never draw the referenced character.

scenes.title: サイトの ページの 見取り図
scenes.scene: Scene: a flat overhead diagram of a website map on cream. One large rounded card sits at the top centre. Thin soft curved lines fan down from it to seven smaller rounded cards arranged neatly in two rows. Each small card is a different pastel colour and holds ONE simple pictogram in its middle instead of any writing: an office building, a calendar, a wrench, a lightbulb, a handshake, a globe, and a graduation cap. Clean, evenly spaced, nothing else in the picture.

scenes.title: 3つの はたらきかた
scenes.scene: Scene: a flat infographic with three rounded pastel panels side by side on cream, each panel clearly separated. Left panel: a small friendly office building handing a wrapped gift box across to a smiling customer figure, with a soft arrow pointing from the building to the customer. Middle panel: a small office building holding its own gift box close, with a heart floating above it. Right panel: a small worker figure carrying a laptop bag, walking along a dotted path out of one small building and into a larger differently coloured building. Simple and easy to compare at a glance.

scenes.title: 会社の つながり
scenes.scene: Scene: a flat relationship diagram on cream. One larger rounded card sits in the centre holding a simple office building pictogram. Two thick soft curved lines run from it to two smaller rounded cards, one on the left and one on the right, each holding its own smaller building pictogram with a tiny rounded location pin floating just above it. The three cards are different pastel colours. Nothing else - no map, no coastline, no borders.

scenes.title: ちょうさシートの 6つの ブロック
scenes.scene: Scene: a flat illustration of a clipboard lying on cream, its paper divided into six equal rounded pastel sections arranged in two columns of three. Each section holds ONE simple pictogram in the middle instead of writing: an office building, a wrench, a handshake, a trophy, a heart, and a graduation cap. A friendly cartoon hand holding a pencil rests at the lower right edge of the clipboard, about to fill a section.

scenes.title: スマホの メニューを おす
scenes.scene: Scene: a flat illustration of a single smartphone standing upright in the centre of a cream background. On its screen is a simple generic website layout made only of blank pastel blocks and grey placeholder bars - never readable writing. At the top right corner of the screen a hamburger menu icon of three short horizontal lines glows inside a highlighted circle. A friendly cartoon finger comes from the right and taps that icon, with two small tap ripples around it.

scenes.title: やさしい 日本語と 日本語
scenes.scene: Scene: two large rounded speech-bubble cards side by side on cream, with a small rounded toggle switch drawn between them. The LEFT bubble contains three short wavy grey lines drawn far apart with big gaps, looking airy and easy. The RIGHT bubble contains six wavy grey lines drawn close together and tightly packed, looking dense. The wavy lines are abstract squiggles only and must never form readable characters. Below the bubbles a small friendly round cartoon face looks up at them with a curious smile.

scenes.title: はたらく 町の ピン
scenes.scene: Scene: a flat abstract locations diagram on a plain cream background. Four rounded map pins of different pastel colours are placed far apart across the picture, connected by soft dotted curved lines that arc between them. Beside each pin sits one tiny pictogram: a tall office tower, a small low office building, an open laptop, and a graduation cap. There is NO map underneath - no coastlines, no country shapes, no borders, no globe. Just cream space, pins and dotted arcs.

scenes.title: 5つの サービス
scenes.scene: Scene: five rounded pastel cards of exactly the same size standing in one straight row on cream, evenly spaced. Each card holds ONE simple pictogram centred in it and nothing else: (1) a speech bubble with a small gear inside, (2) a map pin with a small video play triangle, (3) a document sheet with a round check seal, (4) a small four-rotor drone, (5) two tiny student figures sitting at one open laptop. Clean, uniform, friendly.

scenes.title: いろいろな お客さま
scenes.scene: Scene: a flat diagram on cream. A friendly medium-sized office building sits in the centre. Four soft curved lines reach out from it toward four rounded cards placed around it. Each card holds ONE simple pictogram: a small car, a group of three little children holding hands, a delivery truck, and a town hall building with a small plain pennant on its roof. Warm, uncluttered, evenly balanced.

scenes.title: 会社の あゆみ
scenes.scene: Scene: a flat horizontal timeline on a cream strip. One thick soft pastel line runs from the left edge to the right edge. Along it sit seven round milestone dots that grow gradually larger from left to right. Three of the dots carry a tiny pictogram above them: a small office building, a handshake, and a graduation cap. Near the right end the line blooms upward into five small rounded cards clustered close together, showing a sudden busy burst. No dates, no writing anywhere.

scenes.title: 学生の チームと リーダー
scenes.scene: Scene: a flat organisation diagram on cream, read top to bottom. At the top a rounded card holds a simple office building pictogram. A soft downward arrow leads to a friendly cartoon project manager figure in a neat shirt standing in the middle with a clipboard. Another soft downward arrow leads to three small student figures sitting side by side at open laptops along the bottom. One curved arrow rises from the students back up to the manager, and a small rounded speech bubble sits on that rising arrow - empty inside, no writing.
